local_search.inspected: mathlib Lie adjoint-action and semisimplicity modules, matrix/bilinear/determinant modules; local SL2 spanning, complex escape, centralizer and near-identity sources.
local_search.finding: General Lie irreducibility does not directly supply our actual finite-word and polynomial determinant budget. A concrete bracket identity plus existing inverse coordinates and finite selection does. Crucially, an existing local bounded-word distance theorem removed the need to rebuild a word-error chain. No claim of global absence of another formalization.
